bookSourceComment: 合成夹具（#563 abs:href 锁）。不含任何第三方站点抓取内容。

ruleSearch.author: @js:JSON.parse(result).author
ruleSearch.bookList:
<js>
(function(){
var doc=org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(String(result),'https://example.test/');
var es=doc.select('a.book-card[href^="/novel"]');
var out=[];
for(var i=0;i<es.size();i++){
 var e=es.get(i);
 var u=String(e.attr('abs:href'));
 if(!u)continue;
 var t=e.select('.book-title').first()==null?'':e.select('.book-title').first().text();
 var au=e.select('.book-author').first()==null?'':e.select('.book-author').first().text();
 out.push(JSON.stringify({'name':t,'author':au,'url':u,'coverUrl':EX_B+'/cover/img/'+(1000+i)+'.jpg'}));
}
return out;
})()
</js>
ruleSearch.name: @js:JSON.parse(result).name
